purpose: First closed-set pre-LLM surface-authorship calibration pilot for Joel Rosenblum versus two same-platform/topic controls. This is a pilot, not a validated register threshold.

training.document_weighting: one-document-one-training-example; equal document count per author

held_out_test.include_rule: source_group must contain held-out samples from at least two authors

models.features: TF-IDF character 2-4 grams plus TF-IDF word 1-2 grams
models.caveat: The paper describes this feature/classifier recipe, but released helper-code discrepancies mean exact implementation equivalence is not asserted. Scikit-learn vectorizer defaults are recorded in the receipt.

interpretation.reason: This is a single closed-set original-authorship pilot, not an original-vs-rewrite IER experiment.
